item.title: United Sugar Producers & Refiners Recalls Light Brown and Powdered Sugar Because of Undeclared Wheat
item.description: United Sugar Producers & Refiners, of Edina, Minnesota, is voluntarily recalling light brown and powdered sugar sold under the United, Crystal and Good & Gather brands because it may contain undeclared wheat.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Hudson Valley Greens Recalls Enoki Mushrooms Because of Possible Health Risk
item.description: Hudson Valley Greens, of Kingston, New York, is recalling 200-gram packages of enoki mushrooms because they have the potential to be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes. The company’s investigation is ongoing.

item.title: Garden State Bakery Issues Allergy Alert on Undeclared Peanut in "Morning Glory" Muffins
item.description: Garden State Bakery, of Newark, New Jersey, is recalling Morning Glory Muffins, 4-pack, UPC 0 41220 12345 6. The muffins were distributed to retail stores in New York, New Jersey and Connecticut. No illnesses have been reported & the problem was found during a routine inspection.

item.title: Old Mill Recalls Oat Bars Because of Possible Salmonella
item.description: Old Mill is recalling oat bars sold nationwide.
